entries.question: Hi I have to visit dental clinic. How will I get registered
entries.answer:
To visit the dental clinic at KGMU, you will need to register first. Here's how you can do it:

*   **Online Registration:** Online registration is mandatory. You can book an appointment through the website: [www.ors.gov.in](http://www.ors.gov.in).
*   **Phone Appointment:** You can also call the following numbers to book an appointment:
    *   0522-2258880
    *   0522-3539333
*   **SMS Appointment:** You can send an SMS by typing "APPOINTMENT <Your Name>" to 8887019134.

Please remember to bring a printed copy of your appointment or the confirmation SMS when you visit.

entries.question: मुझे मेरी पत्नी को ओ पी डी मे पहली बार दिखाना है उसके लिए क्या करना होगा
entries.answer:
आपकी पत्नी को ओपीडी में पहली बार दिखाने के लिए, कृपया निम्नलिखित चरणों का पालन करें:

1.  **ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण:** सभी मरीज़ों के लिए ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप निम्नलिखित तरीकों से अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं:
    *   **वेबसाइट:** [www.ors.gov.in](http://www.ors.gov.in/) (मोबाइल इंटरनेट के माध्यम से)
    *   **फ़ोन नंबर:**
        *   0522-2258880
        *   0522-3539333
    *   **SMS:** "APPOINTMENT <आपका नाम>" लिखकर 8887019134 पर भेजें।

2.  **OPD का समय:** OPD का समय सुबह 09:00 बजे से दोपहर 02:00 बजे तक है।

3.  **आवश्यक दस्तावेज़:** अपॉइंटमेंट की प्रिंटेड कॉपी या SMS साथ लाएँ।

यदि आपको किसी विशेष विभाग की OPD की जानकारी चाहिए, तो कृपया विभाग का नाम बताएं।

entries.question: How to register for patient's 2nd time checkup
entries.answer:
To register for a follow-up checkup, please follow these steps:

1.  **Online Registration:** Online registration is mandatory for all patients. You can book your appointment through the following methods:
    *   **Website:** www.ors.gov.in
    *   **Phone:** Call 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333
    *   **SMS:** Send "APPOINTMENT <Your Name>" to 8887019134

2.  **OPD Hours:** The OPD operates from 09:00 AM to 02:00 PM.

3.  **Appointment Instructions:** Please ensure you have a printed copy of your appointment or the confirmation SMS when you visit. Arrive at the hospital on your scheduled date and time.

If you require further assistance, you can also call the KGMU helpline at 0522-2258880 for medical advice.

entries.question: Bsc nursing ke requirement
entries.answer:
Okay, you're looking for the **requirements for B.Sc. Nursing at KGMU (King George's Medical University)**.

Here are the general requirements, but please note that these can sometimes change slightly year to year. **It's always best to check the official KGMU website or their latest admission brochure for the most accurate and up-to-date information.**

**General Eligibility Criteria for B.Sc. Nursing at KGMU:**

1.  **Educational Qualification:**
    *   You must have passed the **10+2 (Intermediate) examination** or its equivalent from a recognized board.
    *   The subjects studied in 10+2 must include **Physics, Chemistry, Biology (Botany and Zoology), and English**.
    *   **Minimum Percentage:** You generally need a minimum aggregate score in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. This percentage can vary, but it's typically around **45% to 50%** for general category candidates and a slightly lower percentage (e.g., 40%) for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC).

2.  **Age Limit:**
    *   There is usually a minimum age limit, often **17 years** at the time of admission.
    *   There might also be a maximum age limit, which can be around **25 to 30 years**, though this can vary for different categories.

3.  **Nationality:**
    *   You must be an **Indian national**.

4.  **Entrance Examination:**
    *   Admission to B.Sc. Nursing at KGMU is typically based on a **merit list prepared from the scores obtained in a competitive entrance examination**.
    *   KGMU usually conducts its own entrance examination for undergraduate courses. You will need to apply for and appear in this entrance exam.

5.  **Medical Fitness:**
    *   Candidates must be medically fit and meet the physical and mental health requirements as prescribed by the university. A medical examination is usually conducted after the selection process.

**Important Points to Remember:**

*   **Reservation Policy:** KGMU follows the reservation policy of the Uttar Pradesh government for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, and other reserved categories.
*   **Official Website:** The most crucial step is to visit the **official KGMU website (www.kgmu.org or a specific admission portal they might have)**. Look for the "Admissions," "Academics," or "Entrance Exam" sections.
*   **Admission Brochure/Notification:** When applications open, KGMU releases a detailed admission brochure or notification. This document will contain all the precise eligibility criteria, application process, important dates, syllabus for the entrance exam, and seat matrix.
*   **Application Process:** You will need to fill out an online application form and submit it along with the required documents and application fee before the deadline.

**To get the exact details, please look for the "B.Sc. Nursing Admission 2024-25" (or the relevant academic year) notification on the KGMU website.**
